assets.name: detailed-aviation-f16
assets.author: k.botond431
assets.used_for: Detailed F-16 flight and parked aircraft; source landing gear also adapted for the parked Rafale.
assets.changes: Preserve the exact original GLB and extracted textures. Landing gear geometry and its credited materials are also reused in SM_AU_Rafale_Parked; that combined derivative is listed under both sources. Native materials retain texture channels, factors and transparency.

assets.name: detailed-aviation-rafale
assets.author: quick_loop
assets.used_for: Detailed Rafale flight and parked aircraft; parked derivative includes separately credited F-16 landing gear.
assets.changes: Preserve the exact original GLB and extracted textures. Convert source glossiness and dielectric reflectance into linear native material masks, normalize geometry to 15.27m, retain source UVs and add measured weapon and twin-nozzle sockets. The parked derivative combines this airframe with adapted landing gear and materials from detailed-aviation-f16; both source entries identify the shared derivative.

assets.name: detailed-aviation-hangar
assets.author: jimbogies
assets.used_for: Detailed enclosed metal aircraft hangars at the defended airfield.
assets.changes: Preserve the original GLB with all embedded textures and credits. Infer inch units from source dimensions and scale by0.0254; remove the included DA42 aircraft, tiny low-resolution cardboard boxes, tape and paired labels. Retain 26,306 building triangles, frames, cladding, ducts, floor and ceiling fixtures. Preserve mapped publisher UVs and normals; add planar UVs only to untextured utility surfaces. Native materials and Nanite geometry retain the source surface appearance. The helijah DA42 credit remains applicable to the retained original GLB even though the rendered building derivative excludes the aircraft.

assets.name: detailed-aviation-tower
assets.author: Lucas Sobral
assets.used_for: Detailed 57m control tower with complete 4K and 2K PBR texture sets.
assets.changes: Preserve the exact original GLB and six embedded maps. Combine both source meshes into a grounded 86,168-triangle Nanite derivative at metre scale while retaining original UVs and corner normals. Native material graphs use base color, packed occlusion/roughness/metallic and correctly handed normal maps.

assets.name: detailed-aviation-tu22
assets.author: helijah
assets.version: Separate CC BY author download retained 2026-10-17
assets.used_for: Textured Tu-22 airborne bomber with detailed airframe, cockpit and twin exhaust outlets.
assets.changes: Retain the separately supplied CC BY GLB and all 23 original color images byte for byte. Preserve authored metre scale, corner UVs and split normals; remove 23,322 triangles of measured exposed landing wheels, struts and links while retaining static bay doors and nacelles. The 41,659-triangle flight derivative adds measured twin-nozzle, rear defensive-gun and bomb-bay sockets. Native materials preserve color maps, source roughness/metallic constants and glass transparency. The exterior atlas is 1024x1024, other source maps are 256 to1024 pixels, and there are no authored normal, roughness, metallic or occlusion images. This is a textured baseline, not a high-resolution PBR or AAA-quality certification. No geometry or images from the separately rejected source edition are included.
